# Toml Elixir v3.1.0 - Table of Contents

Modern TOML parser and encoder for Elixir with protocol-based struct support

## Pages

- [TomlElixir](https://toml-elixir.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://toml-elixir.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [TomlElixir](https://toml-elixir.hexdocs.pm/TomlElixir.md): # TomlElixir
- [TomlElixir.Encoder](https://toml-elixir.hexdocs.pm/TomlElixir.Encoder.md): Protocol for encoding Elixir terms to TOML.
- [TomlElixir.Parser](https://toml-elixir.hexdocs.pm/TomlElixir.Parser.md): TOML parser entry point.

- Exceptions
  - [TomlElixir.Parser.Error](https://toml-elixir.hexdocs.pm/TomlElixir.Parser.Error.md): Exception raised during TOML parsing.
